name: 4-Across: ball to 3
subtitle: Press break, second option
goal: Same pattern as ball to 5, on the opposite side.
options: Inbound: 5 first, then 3, then 1. After the catch: sideline, middle, long, or back to 4.

steps.note: 5 is covered, so 4 hits 3 on the other side.
On the catch: 2 angle-cuts to the sideline at half court, 1 angle-cuts to the center circle, 5 goes long to the basket, and 4 steps in behind as the safety.
3 looks up the floor and takes whoever is open: 2 on the sideline, 1 in the middle, 5 long, or 4 behind.
